name: olive oil pie crust
instructions:
An olive oil pie crust — no butter, no shortening, no chilling. From Six Clever Sisters (Rachel Barkowski). UNATTEMPTED — transcribed, not yet tried.

MAKES A DOUBLE CRUST.

=== INGREDIENTS ===

- 2 2/3 cups flour
- 1 tsp salt
- 2/3 cup olive oil
- 6 tbsp milk

=== PROCEDURE ===

1. Mix the flour and salt in a mixing bowl.
2. CUT THE OIL IN with a pastry cutter, just like you would butter or shortening — no need to chill or freeze the oil. Work it to crumbly-combined.
3. Add the milk and mix with a fork until combined. IT WILL BE WETTER THAN TYPICAL PIE DOUGH — that's expected.
4. ROLL BETWEEN WAX PAPER: roll half the dough out between two sheets of wax paper (nothing sticks to the rolling pin). Peel off the top sheet, flip the crust into the pan, then remove the second sheet.
5. Fill the pie, then repeat the rolling/flipping for the top crust. Crimp the edges and cut vents as usual.
6. BAKE per the pie you're making. Her chicken-pot-pie schedule: 400°F for the first 15 minutes, then down to 350°F for another ~25 minutes. For custard pies (pumpkin) or wet fillings (spanakopita-style), partially bake the bottom crust before filling; for apple / chicken pot pie, no pre-bake needed.
notes:
=== STATUS — HAVEN'T TRIED IT YET ===

Transcribed on promise: her claim is it beats any shortening or butter crust she's had, with zero extra steps (no chilling at all). To be tested against [[butter-pie-crust]].

=== TECHNIQUE NOTES (HERS) ===

- The oil cuts into the dry mix exactly like cold butter would — the whole convenience case is skipping the chill.
- The dough runs wetter than a typical pie dough; the wax-paper sandwich is what makes it workable.
- Deep-dish pyrex pans recommended — regular-size pans overflow easily.
- Canola worked when she was out of olive oil; light olive oil should be fine too.
- Gluten-free note from her comments: 1:1 GF flour absorbs more — cut the flour back.

=== SHOULD HAVE SUGAR (I THINK) ===

I think this crust should have SUGAR — and the commenters agree: the base recipe has none, but the well-reviewed commenter version adds 1 tsp. (Note [[butter-pie-crust]] carries 1 tbsp sugar — the sugarless base here is the outlier.)

=== MONYA'S VARIANT — TRY THIS ONE FIRST ===

The commenter version (Monya Motley, 'Excellent pie crust! Perfect everytime'): 2 1/2 cups flour, 1/2 cup olive oil, 1/2 cup 1% milk, 1 TSP SUGAR, pinch of salt.

FOR EXPERIMENTING: I'm interested in trying MONYA'S VARIANT FIRST — it has the sugar, and the rounder 1/2-cup measures.

=== THE PASTRY CRUST FAMILY ===

- [[butter-pie-crust]]: the house crust (butter/shortening, 1/2 cup fat). This recipe is the challenger — vegan-adjacent (milk aside), pantry-stable fat, no chill.
- [[rolled-oats-pie-top]]: the crumble-side topping.
- [[atk-galette-dough]]: the galette dough — this olive oil crust is NOT that either.
